beta.notes:
Nav, Home, Training, muscle taxonomy and Library refactor.

- Floating pill tab bar (Home / Training / Library) with a detached Pump button; Pump is now a modal and badges when a workout is running. Schedule and Progress are absorbed into Training.
- Muscles are a fixed two-level tree (7 groups, 27 muscles). Exercises target several muscles, one primary, and gain an equipment field. Workout screens show the subgroups trained.
- Training tab: month activity grids, cumulative activity summary vs the previous period (30D/3M/6M/1Y), strength volume by muscle group, per-exercise progression, activity history with text import.
- Home: "Today, <date>" opening a calendar drawer, weekly snapshot with week-over-week deltas, one timeline mixing your activity with people you follow, PR trophies.

Requires database migrations 031-033.

Fixes: exercise edits could leave an exercise with no muscles and drop it from every chart; imported exercises matched no muscle filter; the home timeline stopped after one page; failed fetches showed "no activity yet" instead of an error; list rows sat under the Pump button; durations could read "1h 60m"; Body Stats regained an entry point on the profile screen.

nightly.notes:
### Improved

- The workout Live Activity is redesigned. The lock screen shows the exercise, your set and its target, a bar of every set in the session and what's next; while you rest, a big countdown with a draining ring and what's up next.
- The Dynamic Island shows sets done and the session clock while you lift, and the rest countdown while you rest.
- The tab bar now reads Home, Training, Library, Journal.
- Titles stay readable when you scroll: the content passing under the top bar is softly blurred instead of showing through.
- The segmented controls (Training's timeframe, the Library's sections and others) match the rest of the app, and the selected option is easier to read.
- Save, Done and other main actions at the top of a screen are white, so they no longer look like Cancel.
- The thin line under the top bar is gone.

### Fixed

- The calendar opened from your profile no longer flickers a grey band over its content.
